title: Unified Behavioral Intelligence Curriculum (6MX + Ellipsis Manual) — Tier 1 Bundle

Signal/Indicator.definition: Externally observable, timestamped behavioral data (somatic cue, vocal shift, linguistic marker, facial movement). Must be visible or audible on camera.

Internal State/Driver.definition: Unobservable psychological motive, fear, autonomic arousal state, or identity construct inferred from signals. Never treated as direct fact without confirmation.

Cognitive Mechanism.definition: Underlying information-processing rule, attentional filter, or decision architecture that converts inputs into internal shifts or behavior.

Tactical Lever.definition: Deliberate operator adjustment—postural, framing, questioning, or structural—deployed to gather information, stabilize rapport, or shift compliance.

Failure Mode.definition: Diagnostic error, false positive, operator bias, or second-order relational blowback that corrupts accuracy or breaks trust.

operator-baseline.definition: The practitioner's calibrated emotional, postural, and attentional neutrality prior to contact; prevents operator noise from distorting subject telemetry.

the-four-lenses.definition: Sequential perceptual filter (Broken -> Different -> Facts -> Reasons) used to strip moral judgment and isolate causal behavior.

the-four-laws-of-human-behavior.canonicalTerm: The Four Laws of Human Behavior
the-four-laws-of-human-behavior.definition: Foundational heuristic framing human behavior around universal insecurity, protective masks, early conditioning, and need-driven action.

observer-distortion.definition: Contamination of a subject's natural output caused by the operator's own anxiety, ego-reactivity, dominance overplay, or visible scrutiny.

hypothesis-plurality.definition: Holding two or more competing Lens 4 causal explanations in suspension until an active probe yields disconfirming or confirming data.

autonomic-decay-lag.definition: The physiological braking time (typically 45-90 seconds) required for sympathetic constriction to subside after a stressor or Observer Distortion is removed.

exogenous-noise.definition: Behavioral constriction or distraction caused by factors outside the interaction (illness, temperature, prior events) that mimics stimulus-linked stress.

authority-architecture.definition: Deliberate calibration of physical presence, vocal cadence, non-reactivity, and spatial command that lowers a subject's resistance threshold and stabilizes compliance before a substantive request is made.

first-contact-frame.definition: The implicit social hierarchy and relational expectations established in the opening 30-90 seconds of an interaction, which governs how all subsequent questions and directives are interpreted.

status-tension-leak.definition: Micro-behaviors betraying an operator's need for approval or fear of pushback (upward vocal inflection, rushed speech, fidgeting, excessive nodding, or over-explaining) that instantly collapse perceived authority.

dominance-overplay.definition: Confusing loud aggression, rigid posturing, or territorial hostility with authority; triggers immediate Observer Distortion and defensive armor rather than voluntary compliance.

autonomy-margin.definition: The variable threshold of directive pressure a specific subject can absorb before perceiving territorial encroachment and triggering Dominance Overplay.

frame-maintenance-decay.definition: The collapse of an initially strong First-Contact Frame caused by mid-interaction Status-Tension Leaks or lack of directional utility.

subject-baseline.definition: A subject's normal, low-stress spectrum of posture, blink rate, vocal pitch, and gesture cadence established in neutral conversation before any high-stakes stimulus is introduced.

primary-social-need.definition: The dominant social currency a subject prioritizes (Significance, Approval, Acceptance, Intelligence, Pity, Strength/Power) to stabilize self-worth.

hidden-fear-map.definition: The exact inverse shadow of a Primary Social Need—the specific vulnerability or status loss the subject actively defends against.

fate-engine.definition: Four-variable prioritization architecture (Focus, Authority, Tribe, Emotion) governing how attention and rapid decisions lock in before conscious rationalization.

protective-mask.definition: Habitual social persona projected to secure a Primary Social Need while concealing the underlying Hidden Fear Map.

compliance-ladder.definition: Sequenced escalation of low-friction micro-agreements that builds behavioral momentum before a higher-stakes request.

psychological-reactance.definition: Defensive pushback triggered when a subject perceives their autonomy is being cornered, instantly collapsing rapport and compliance.

mentalModel.proseMarkdown:
A seismograph does not measure earthquakes by being sensitive; it measures them by being still. Bolt the instrument to solid bedrock with its needle resting at absolute zero, and even a distant tremor registers as clean geometry. Set that exact same instrument on a rattling wooden table, and the needle scribbles violently—not because the earth moved, but because the housing itself is shaking. Every reading becomes a portrait of the machine's own vibration.

Behavioral profiling fails at this exact joint. Most people walk into an interaction assuming their eyes and ears are transparent glass, passively recording who the other person 'really is.' In reality, an uncalibrated observer is a seismograph on a shaking table. Two internal forces rattle the housing before a single reliable signal can be logged: **moralistic distortion** (judging behavior as good, arrogant, stupid, or shady) and **somatic leakage** (broadcasting your own tension, skepticism, or hunger for control into the room).

**Operator Baseline** is the act of bolting the instrument to bedrock. It strips away ego-reactivity and physical tension so your presence exerts minimum involuntary pressure on the subject. Once the housing is still, **The Four Lenses** function as the optical prism—grinding down reactive labels until only raw movement and causal mechanics remain. Finally, **The Four Laws of Human Behavior** supply the geological map beneath the crust: the operating premise that human conduct is rarely random malice or pure rationality, but a predictable system of load-bearing defenses built around insecurity, early grooves, and unmet social needs.

Mastery in this system is never the accumulation of trivia about body language. Knowledge sits in the prefrontal cortex like an unread manual; skill is a zeroed instrument that reads pressure changes without flinching.

granularMechanics.causalChainsMarkdown:
### Mechanism A: The Lens-Shift Cascade (The Four Lenses)
Raw visual and auditory data never reaches conscious awareness untouched. **The Four Lenses** force automatic social-verdict compression to run in reverse across four altitudes:
1. **Lens 1 — Broken:** Moral condemnation (*'He's defensive and dishonest'*). Terminates inquiry and starts confirmation hunting.
2. **Lens 2 — Different:** Distance without hostility (*'He handles pressure differently than I do'*). Lowers heat but keeps the operator as the reference norm.
3. **Lens 3 — Facts:** Camera-level stripping (*'When budget numbers came up, blink rate doubled, shoulders rose, torso pivoted 15 degrees'*). Amputates every adjective a microphone or lens cannot capture.
4. **Lens 4 — Reasons:** Causal reconstruction (*'What internal pressure, fear, or incentive makes pivoting away the most logical protective move right now?'*).

Lens 4 is not a license to trade moral mind-reading for clinical mind-reading. A clean shift from *Facts* to *Reasons* never lands on a single certainty; it deploys **Hypothesis Plurality**—widening the aperture into a bracket of competing pressures. You hold two or three plausible motives in tension (avoidance, time pressure, status defense) like counterweights on a scale, refusing to let the needle settle until a second data point tips the balance.

*Micro-Scenario:* A senior director interrupts a junior analyst twice and stares at his phone during the Q3 forecast. Shifting to Lens 3 strips the event to camera facts (*interruption exclusively during margin-loss slides; 4-second dead-screen gaze*), and Lens 4 holds competing hypotheses (avoidance around margin accountability vs. prior briefing urgency) ready to test. [L2-HOOK:L2-M01-four-lens-shift]

### Mechanism B: The Insecurity-to-Mask Architecture (The Four Laws of Human Behavior)
- **Universal Insecurity (The Load):** Specific areas of perceived vulnerability or insufficiency.
- **Early Conditioning (The Groove):** Repeated early experiences wiring default survival strategies.
- **Mask Projection (The Shell):** Wired strategies hardening into a **Protective Mask** (M08) designed to conceal insecurity while pulling in a **Primary Social Need** (M05).
- **Behavioral Output (The Signal):** A **Protective Mask** does not broadcast at full power in an empty room; it idles until a live social stimulus presses against the exact seam of the underlying insecurity. What looks like sudden 'personality' or overreaction on the surface is the friction spike produced at that precise point of contact—the faster and heavier the behavioral flare, the closer the stimulus landed to the unguarded fault line underneath.

*Micro-Scenario:* A colleague relentlessly corrects minor terminology errors in group meetings, using precision as a **Protective Mask** flare when status evaluation rises. [L2-HOOK:L2-M01-mask-vs-fact]

### Mechanism C: The Contagion Loop (Operator Baseline vs. Observer Distortion)
`Operator internal tension / judgment` -> `Micro-leakage (stiff jaw, locked stare, clipped vocal tempo)` -> `Subject's threat-detection system spikes` -> `Subject shifts out of Subject Baseline (M03) into defensive constriction` -> `Operator misreads defensive constriction as guilt, resistance, or deception`.

This closed loop is **Observer Distortion**. You did not discover a tremor in the subject; you bumped the table and logged your own impact. Watch the *trajectory*, not just the snapshot: nervous systems carry braking distance (**Autonomic Decay Lag** of 45-90 seconds) even after you soften, and constriction present prior to contact may be **Exogenous Noise**. [L2-HOOK:L2-M01-observer-distortion]

sensorToActuatorLoops.title: Pre-Contact Zeroing
sensorToActuatorLoops.sensorInput: Internal urge to label a subject ('shady,' 'needy,' 'hostile') or somatic tightness in operator's own shoulders/jaw.
sensorToActuatorLoops.interpreterHypothesis: Lens 1 contamination active; high risk of triggering Observer Distortion.
sensorToActuatorLoops.actuatorCalibration: Exhale slowly, drop vocal tempo by 10-15%, physically soften posture, and restate the observation strictly in Lens 3 (camera facts).
sensorToActuatorLoops.feedbackSignal: Subject's posture opens, breathing deepens, and speech cadence stabilizes within 30-60 seconds.

sensorToActuatorLoops.title: Distortion Isolation Test
sensorToActuatorLoops.sensorInput: Subject displays sudden defensive constriction (clipped answers, gaze aversion, leaning back) mid-conversation.
sensorToActuatorLoops.interpreterHypothesis: Ambiguous (Hypothesis Plurality): topic sensitivity vs. Observer Distortion from operator cadence vs. Exogenous Noise.
sensorToActuatorLoops.actuatorCalibration: Deliberately lower intensity—lean back 2 inches, pause 2 full seconds after they speak, shift to a neutral open question.
sensorToActuatorLoops.feedbackSignal: Allowing for Autonomic Decay Lag (45-90s), if constriction bleeds off, it was Observer Distortion. Log a genuine stimulus-linked shift only if constriction re-spikes when returning to the target topic after the room cools.

commonMisconceptions: Deadpan Robot Misconception: mistaking Operator Baseline for cold, expressionless stillness, which reads as predatory evaluation and accelerates Observer Distortion.
Lens 4 Over-Pathologizing Trap: inventing deep childhood wounds to explain a subject who is simply tired, cold, or rushing (Exogenous Noise).
highProbabilityFalsePositives: Reading a subject's reaction to your own stiff posture or rapid cadence as baseline nervousness or guilt.
Confusing slow autonomic recovery (Autonomic Decay Lag) with persistent topic sensitivity.
disconfirmingEvidenceRules: Run the Distortion Isolation Test first: if softening your cadence and posture dissolves their tension within 45-90 seconds, your hypothesis of subject deception or topic sensitivity is falsified.

secondOrder: Unchecked Observer Distortion corrupts Subject Baseline (M03), turning the entire Tier 2-4 sensor suite into a false-positive generator.
thirdOrder: A subject who feels silently scrutinized under Lens 1 tags the operator as an interrogator, keeping their Protective Mask (M08) permanently elevated across future encounters.

Your peer immediately leans back, crosses arms tightly, avoids eyes, and gives clipped five-word answers.

Put the pen down, lean back, slow vocal cadence, and reframe neutrally ('I'm rushing us—let's step back. From your side, where did the handoff feel tightest?'). Watch whether constriction drops across 45-90s before forming hypotheses.

L2-M01-four-lens-shift.operationalFocus: Stripping moralistic Lens 1 verdicts into camera-grade Lens 3 facts and multi-hypothesis Lens 4 models.

workedExample.setting: Quarterly budget review with a VP of Operations and two analysts.
workedExample.sceneMarkdown: Advancing to the fulfillment cost-overrun slide, the VP cuts off your analyst ('We've seen these numbers, move on'), shifts his chair back 4 inches, and stares at his phone for 5 seconds without touching the screen.

ctaLoop.baseline: During the first 12 minutes, VP leaned forward, asked clarifying questions, and left phone face-down.
ctaLoop.deviationOrCluster: Abrupt interruption + 4-inch postural withdrawal + 5-second dead-screen gaze synchronized to the fulfillment-overrun slide.
ctaLoop.internalDriverHypothesis: Hypothesis Plurality: (A) Feels exposed on overruns and uses urgency to bury scrutiny; OR (B) Already briefed CFO yesterday and views slide as wasted airtime.
ctaLoop.tacticalProbeOrActuator: Bypass Lens 1 irritation; speak calmly in Lens 3 tone: 'Got it—if you already walked the CFO through the variance, I'll skip the breakdown and jump straight to Q4 mitigation options.'
ctaLoop.observableFeedbackAndNextMove: Shoulders drop, phone flips face-down, and he replies: 'Actually, hold on—let's make sure mitigation matches what I told Finance.' Collaborative buy-in unlocked.

deceptiveNonExample.mirrorSceneMarkdown: On the fulfillment-overrun slide, VP interrupts ('Hold on, skip ahead a second'), pulls back, and stares at his phone for 5 seconds.
deceptiveNonExample.benignRootCause: Exogenous Noise: silent watch buzz alerted him to a high-priority warehouse floor outage; reading lock-screen alert without unlocking.
deceptiveNonExample.disconfirmingCue: 30 seconds later on a neutral office-supplies slide, he glances at phone again, exhales, taps a two-word reply, and apologizes ('Sorry, dock sensor tripped—go back to that fulfillment slide').
deceptiveNonExample.falsePositiveCost: Pressing harder on fulfillment accountability makes you look tone-deaf and adversarial while he manages an unrelated operational fire.

L2-M01-mask-vs-fact.operationalFocus: Distinguishing a threat-triggered Protective Mask flare from legitimate domain rigor.

workedExample.setting: Cross-functional product roadmap meeting with newly hired Director of Strategy attending for the first time.
workedExample.sceneMarkdown: A senior manager interrupts a peer three times in ten minutes to correct minor vocabulary ('KPI, not OKR'; 'latency, not throughput'), glancing toward the new Director after each correction.

ctaLoop.baseline: In prior weekly syncs without senior leadership, manager used casual shorthand and never policed terminology.
ctaLoop.deviationOrCluster: Sudden precision policing + post-correction eye-checks toward highest-status attendee + elevated vocal volume.
ctaLoop.internalDriverHypothesis: New executive pressed on fear of appearing non-essential; Protective Mask flaring through technical nitpicking to claim competence currency.
ctaLoop.tacticalProbeOrActuator: Validate competence directly without feeding derailment: 'Good catch—your team's technical rigor is why we rely on your sign-off for Phase 2. Let's capture exact terms in notes and keep moving.'
ctaLoop.observableFeedbackAndNextMove: Interruptions stop immediately; manager leans back and shifts from policing to constructive problem-solving.

deceptiveNonExample.setting: Pre-submission review of a client contract and regulatory compliance deck.
deceptiveNonExample.mirrorSceneMarkdown: A compliance lead interrupts three times to correct phrasing ('Do not write guarantees, write designed to support'; 'data processor, not controller').
deceptiveNonExample.benignRootCause: Legitimate statutory risk management—wrong legal terms create binding liability regardless of audience.
deceptiveNonExample.disconfirmingCue: Applies identical precision in private 1-on-1 drafts with zero audience, never checks room for status reactions, and welcomes corrections from junior lawyers.
deceptiveNonExample.falsePositiveCost: Brushing off critical risk warnings and subtly patronizing a high-value specialist.

L2-M01-observer-distortion.operationalFocus: Running the Distortion Isolation Test to separate operator-induced tension from genuine subject resistance.

workedExample.setting: 1-on-1 check-in with a direct report whose project is three days behind schedule.
workedExample.sceneMarkdown: Pressed for time, you sit on the edge of your chair, tap your pen twice, and ask rapidly: 'Walk me through what happened with vendor specs—did they miss cutoff or did we?' Report immediately folds arms, tucks chin, and answers flatly: 'They missed it.'

ctaLoop.baseline: Usually chatty and open during 1-on-1s, gesturing freely with open palms.
ctaLoop.deviationOrCluster: Immediate arm-fold + chin tuck + abrupt three-word defensive reply right after opening question.
ctaLoop.internalDriverHypothesis: High probability of Observer Distortion—rapid tempo and binary 'who failed' framing triggered a courtroom reflex.
ctaLoop.tacticalProbeOrActuator: Set pen flat, lean back, exhale audibly, and reset: 'Wait—I'm coming in hot from another meeting. Not hunting for blame. Walk me through how the handoff actually played out.'
ctaLoop.observableFeedbackAndNextMove: Across 45 seconds (Autonomic Decay Lag), arms uncross and report volunteers the real bottleneck.

deceptiveNonExample.mirrorSceneMarkdown: You enter calm and ask an open, low-pressure question; report sits with tightly folded arms, tucked chin, and gives flat three-word answers.
deceptiveNonExample.benignRootCause: Exogenous Noise—fighting off a severe migraine after receiving bad personal news ten minutes earlier.
deceptiveNonExample.disconfirmingCue: Constriction preceded your first sentence and remains completely flat despite postural softening and shifting to safe weekend small talk.
deceptiveNonExample.falsePositiveCost: Over-apologizing or probing for a non-existent work cover-up adds friction to someone who simply needs to reschedule.

L3-M01-attribution-bias-lenses.topicTitle: Fundamental Attribution Error, Spontaneous Trait Inference & BARS
L3-M01-attribution-bias-lenses.externalScienceMarkdown: The Four Lenses maps closely onto established social cognition findings on the **Fundamental Attribution Error** (Ross, 1977) and **Spontaneous Trait Inference** (Uleman et al.). Humans encode behaviors as fixed dispositional traits within milliseconds. Structured observation frameworks like **BARS** enforce the exact same Lens 3 discipline—recording observable actions before inferring causes—measurably cutting rater bias.
L3-M01-attribution-bias-lenses.operationalTranslation: Use as-is as a high-reliability cognitive circuit breaker forcing System 2 to override automatic trait labeling.
keyReferences: Uleman et al. (2008) Spontaneous Trait Inference

L3-M01-universal-insecurity-heuristic.externalScienceMarkdown: While framing conduct around insecurity echoes psychodynamic/Adlerian compensation models, **Self-Determination Theory** (Deci & Ryan) and **Approach-Avoidance Motivation** (Elliot) demonstrate humans run on two distinct tracks: *avoidance/threat-defense* and *approach/intrinsic growth* (curiosity, mastery, genuine affiliation). Reducing every behavior to insecurity introduces cynical confirmation bias.
L3-M01-universal-insecurity-heuristic.operationalTranslation: Deploy the insecurity-and-mask lens specifically when detecting defensive friction, overreaction, or status guarding—not as a blanket law for healthy, low-threat behavior.

L3-M01-skill-acquisition-perception.topicTitle: Intuitive Expertise in Wicked vs. High-Validity Environments
L3-M01-skill-acquisition-perception.externalScienceMarkdown: Kahneman & Klein (2009) established that genuine perceptual intuition only develops in **high-validity environments** with fast, unambiguous corrective feedback. Everyday social profiling is a **wicked (low-validity) environment**—people rarely tell you when your silent read was wrong, meaning unverified practice builds *illusion of validity* rather than accuracy.
L3-M01-skill-acquisition-perception.operationalTranslation: Never count unverified observations as reps. Skill compounds only when you test Lens 4 hypotheses via low-stakes probes and log disconfirmations.
keyReferences: Kahneman & Klein (2009) Conditions for Intuitive Expertise

L3-M01-age-12-conditioning.topicTitle: Childhood Behavioral Determinism vs. Lifespan Plasticity
L3-M01-age-12-conditioning.externalScienceMarkdown: The claim that 90% of adult behavioral patterns lock by age 12 has no empirical basis. Longitudinal meta-analyses (Roberts & DelVecchio, 2000; Roberts et al., 2006) show personality rank-order consistency is *lowest* in childhood and rises steadily through adulthood, not plateauing until ages 50-70. Early environments carve default stress scripts, not permanent hardwiring.
L3-M01-age-12-conditioning.operationalTranslation: Discard the 'locked by age 12' statistic completely; retain only the milder Lens 4 curiosity that acute stress can briefly pull adults toward early coping habits.

mentalModel.proseMarkdown:
A body with real gravitational mass never chases satellites, never shouts to hold their attention, and never flinches when debris drifts past. It simply occupies space with dense, unhurried stillness—curving the geometry of the room until lighter, more anxious energies settle into orbit around it.

That is the core architecture of behavioral authority. Most people mistake authority for *thrust*—volume, speed, sharp gestures, or aggressive eye contact. Thrust burns fuel, generates heat, and triggers pushback. True **Authority Architecture** is *mass*. Built directly on top of **Operator Baseline** (M01), it is the visible absence of internal hurry, approval-seeking, or threat reactivity. When an operator enters a room with zeroed stillness, unhurried movement, and downward vocal cadence, the subject's nervous system performs an instant, pre-conscious calculation: *This person is not competing for status, not asking for permission, and not rattled by uncertainty.*

Stillness alone, however, is not gravity—it is just dead weight. Somatic mass only bends the room when it is paired with unmistakable directional intent. The moment your pause ends, the words that follow must cut straight to structure, clarity, or a concrete next step; otherwise, the subject's nervous system reclassifies your unhurried silence as hesitation rather than command.

In that split second, the **First-Contact Frame** locks into place. Encountering a calm, high-certainty anchor lowers the subject's cognitive load—serving both halves of the curriculum: for the *sensor* (6MX), calm authority lets the subject drop into a clean **Subject Baseline** (M03); for the *actuator* (EM), it lowers the friction threshold for every question, reframe, and directive that follows.

granularMechanics.causalChainsMarkdown:
### Mechanism A: The Somatic Broadcast (Authority Architecture vs. Status-Tension Leak)
Authority is transmitted through three synchronized physical channels before a persuasive argument is spoken:
1. **Tempo (Vocal & Kinetic Braking):** Dropping speech rate 10-15%, pausing a full beat before answering, and downward terminal inflection signal finality. Rushing silence or upward inflection emits a **Status-Tension Leak**.
2. **Geometry (Unapologetic Space):** Open torso, relaxed shoulders, grounded feet, minimal deliberate gestures claim space without encroaching on the subject's perimeter.
3. **Non-Reactivity (The Shock Absorber):** Absorbing early interruptions or skepticism with a two-second pause and calm curiosity confirms mass is real, not performed.

*Micro-Scenario:* Interrupted by a skeptical VP (*'Three agencies failed us'*), a consultant holds a calm two-second pause, lowers pitch, and redirects: *'Then let's skip the standard deck—tell me what the last three missed.'* [L2-HOOK:L2-M02-non-reactivity-frame-hold]

### Mechanism B: The Compliance-Friction Curve (First-Contact Frame)
`Calm somatic mass + directional clarity` -> `Subject registers high certainty + low threat` -> `Vigilance and defensive energy drop` -> `Subject defaults to clean answers and structural transitions` -> `Lowered activation energy for downstream elicitation and compliance`.

Treat this ratchet as a live tension mechanism, not a permanent weld. A strong opening buys you low-friction runway, but a single **Status-Tension Leak** mid-conversation—such as over-justifying a reasonable boundary or rushing to fill a ten-second silence—triggers **Frame-Maintenance Decay**, releasing the pawl and forcing you to rebuild under heavier scrutiny. [L2-HOOK:L2-M02-first-contact-ratchet]

### Mechanism C: The Authority-Threat Cliff (Dominance Overplay)
Crucially, the cliff edge does not sit at the same distance for every counterpart. Each subject carries a different **Autonomy Margin**—the amount of directive pressure they can absorb before their nervous system flags it as territorial encroachment. What reads as reassuring leadership to a stressed subordinate can register as blatant **Dominance Overplay** to a high-status peer.

`Excessive dominance cues crossing Autonomy Margin` -> `Subject's autonomic threat system fires` -> `Subject perceives loss of autonomy` -> `Protective Mask (M08) slams shut (Observer Distortion + Psychological Reactance)` -> `Diagnostic telemetry turns to defensive noise and compliance locks up`. [L2-HOOK:L2-M02-dominance-overplay-cliff]

sensorToActuatorLoops.title: Frame-Test Absorption
sensorToActuatorLoops.sensorInput: Subject interrupts early, challenges credentials, or introduces abrupt silence during opening contact.
sensorToActuatorLoops.interpreterHypothesis: Status-calibration test probing whether operator's Authority Architecture is genuine mass or performative shell.
sensorToActuatorLoops.actuatorCalibration: Hold Operator Baseline, pause 2 full seconds without justifying, drop vocal pitch, and redirect with a calm, concrete diagnostic question.
sensorToActuatorLoops.feedbackSignal: Subject's vocal volume drops, interruptions cease, and they answer your questions directly.

sensorToActuatorLoops.title: Overplay Rollback
sensorToActuatorLoops.sensorInput: Subject leans back, narrows gaze, gives terse replies, or mirrors stiff posture immediately after operator enters.
sensorToActuatorLoops.interpreterHypothesis: Potential Dominance Overplay crossing subject's Autonomy Margin (hold Hypothesis Plurality against Exogenous Noise).
sensorToActuatorLoops.actuatorCalibration: Soften geometry (angle torso 15 degrees off-center), warm facial micro-tension, and grant explicit micro-autonomy ('You tell me where you'd like to start').
sensorToActuatorLoops.feedbackSignal: Allowing for Autonomic Decay Lag (45-90s), subject's shoulders drop and sentence length expands.

gradedClaims.claimSummary: Unhurried vocal cadence, downward inflection, and relaxed expansive posture elevate perceived competence and leadership.
gradedClaims.rationale: Consistently replicated across social psychology and thin-slicing research.

gradedClaims.claimSummary: Calm competence/prestige elicits voluntary deference and information sharing, whereas aggressive Dominance Overplay elicits resentment and evasion.
gradedClaims.rationale: Directly supported by Dual Strategies Theory of Status (Henrich & Gil-White; Cheng et al.).

gradedClaims.claimSummary: Non-reactivity and authority presence checklists systematically increase compliance under pressure.
gradedClaims.rationale: High-utility field framework, though sustained compliance requires shared group purpose rather than raw obedience.

gradedClaims.claimSummary: The opening 30-90 second First-Contact Frame anchors interpretation of subsequent interaction.
gradedClaims.rationale: Backed by thin-slicing and primacy research, though frames remain updatable via strong disconfirming competence.

gradedClaims.claimSummary: Specific vocal or postural cues bypass conscious evaluation to trigger automatic 'reptilian/hardwired' obedience.
gradedClaims.rationale: Relies on retired Triune Brain pop-neurology; social deference is a distributed, context-sensitive appraisal.

commonMisconceptions: Alpha Theater Misconception: performing exaggerated slowness or dead-eyed staring, which reads as awkward or hostile incongruence.
Universal-Frame Fallacy: assuming directive command framing works identically across high-autonomy expert rooms.
highProbabilityFalsePositives: Misreading cultural politeness norms as a low-status Status-Tension Leak.
Mistaking an introverted analytical baseline for Dominance Overplay resistance.
disconfirmingEvidenceRules: If your calm authoritative framing causes the subject's answers to get shorter rather than longer over the first two minutes, your presence is registering as threat or Dominance Overplay rather than safety.

secondOrder: A clean First-Contact Frame stabilizes Subject Baseline (M03), making genuine Tier 2 stress clusters stand out in high contrast.
thirdOrder: Relying on Dominance Overplay trains counterparts to withhold bad news and perform superficial agreement, blinding the operator long-term.

fieldCalibrationDrill.scenarioPrompt: Stepping in to lead a deadlocked task force, a senior lead smirks and says: 'Great, another coordinator—do you actually have authority to approve budget, or are you just taking notes?'
fieldCalibrationDrill.deceptiveRedHerring: Reciting your executive sponsor's name defensively (Status-Tension Leak) or snapping back sharply to assert dominance (Dominance Overplay).
fieldCalibrationDrill.idealOperatorResponse: Hold Operator Baseline, pause 2 full seconds with calm eye contact, lower vocal cadence, and answer directly without heat: 'I don't sign the budget—I clear the deadlock so your proposals actually get approved. Give me the two blockers in ninety seconds.'

causalGapPatches.quotedWeakJoint: When an operator enters a room with zeroed stillness, unhurried movement, and downward vocal cadence, the subject's nervous system performs an instant calculation...
causalGapPatches.diagnosis: Treats somatic stillness as self-sufficient; stillness without directional utility reads as hesitation rather than Authority Architecture.
causalGapPatches.surgicalRepairMarkdown: Stillness alone, however, is not gravity—it is just dead weight. Somatic mass only bends the room when it is paired with unmistakable directional intent. The moment your pause ends, the words that follow must cut straight to structure, clarity, or a concrete next step; otherwise, the subject's nervous system reclassifies your unhurried silence as hesitation rather than command.

causalGapPatches.quotedWeakJoint: Once the First-Contact Frame hardens—usually within the first minute—it acts as a ratchet...
causalGapPatches.diagnosis: Implies the opening 60 seconds permanently welds authority; ignores Frame-Maintenance Decay from mid-interaction Status-Tension Leaks.
causalGapPatches.surgicalRepairMarkdown: Treat this ratchet as a live tension mechanism, not a permanent weld. A strong opening buys you low-friction runway, but a single **Status-Tension Leak** mid-conversation—such as over-justifying a reasonable boundary or rushing to fill a ten-second silence—triggers **Frame-Maintenance Decay**, releasing the pawl and forcing you to rebuild under heavier scrutiny.

causalGapPatches.quotedWeakJoint: Push presence too hard—locking unblinking eye contact, invading personal space... and the operator falls off the cliff into Dominance Overplay.
causalGapPatches.diagnosis: Describes Dominance Overplay as fixed extreme behaviors, ignoring that each subject carries a variable Autonomy Margin.
causalGapPatches.surgicalRepairMarkdown: Crucially, the cliff edge does not sit at the same distance for every counterpart. Each subject carries a different **Autonomy Margin**—the amount of directive pressure they can absorb before their nervous system flags it as territorial encroachment. What reads as reassuring leadership to a stressed subordinate can register as blatant **Dominance Overplay** to a high-status peer.

Aligned 'Protective armor' strictly to canonical Protective Mask (M08).

L2-M02-non-reactivity-frame-hold.operationalFocus: Absorbing an early status test without slipping into defensive justification (Status-Tension Leak) or counter-aggression (Dominance Overplay).

workedExample.setting: Initial scoping call with a skeptical VP of Operations evaluating your team for a workflow overhaul.
workedExample.sceneMarkdown: Ninety seconds in, VP cuts across your overview: 'I've sat through four of these pitches this month. Everybody promises streamlined workflows and nobody understands our floor constraints.'

ctaLoop.baseline: Flat affect, leaned back, arms resting on chair rails.
ctaLoop.deviationOrCluster: Sharp mid-sentence interruption + dismissive generalization + raised chin—classic early frame test.
ctaLoop.internalDriverHypothesis: Testing whether you will scramble to prove yourself (low-authority vendor) or hold steady as a peer who handles blunt reality.
ctaLoop.tacticalProbeOrActuator: Stop speaking immediately. Hold calm eye contact 2 full seconds without nervous smiling/nodding, drop vocal pitch, and say: 'Fair—most decks ignore floor reality. Skip the overview: tell me the single bottleneck that broke the last two rollouts.'
ctaLoop.observableFeedbackAndNextMove: VP leans forward, drops sarcastic edge, and details a concrete handoff failure. Frame locked onto peer-level diagnostician.

deceptiveNonExample.setting: Identical scoping call with VP of Operations.
deceptiveNonExample.mirrorSceneMarkdown: Ninety seconds in, VP interrupts briskly: 'Sorry to cut you off—can we jump straight to timeline and pricing?'
deceptiveNonExample.benignRootCause: Genuine calendar compression—prior call ran over and they have a hard stop.
deceptiveNonExample.disconfirmingCue: Hurried rather than combative tone, brief glance at top-right clock, explicit apology for cutting in.
deceptiveNonExample.falsePositiveCost: Deploying a dramatic two-second stony silence wastes their remaining time and makes you look rigid and oblivious.

L2-M02-first-contact-ratchet.operationalFocus: Setting a clean First-Contact Frame through unhurried agenda-setting rather than apologetic filler.

workedExample.setting: First 1-on-1 meeting with a newly assigned cross-functional stakeholder who outranks you by one level.
workedExample.sceneMarkdown: Instead of apologetic filler, you enter on time, sit grounded, pause one beat, and open with downward inflection: 'Glad we got this on the calendar. I have two alignment points so our teams don't duplicate work this quarter—fifteen minutes. Want to start with data handoff or review cadence?'

ctaLoop.baseline: Stakeholder initially distracted, glancing at Slack notifications as call connected.
ctaLoop.deviationOrCluster: Immediate shift to full-screen attention + posture squaring up + calm concise reply ('Let's hit data handoff first').
ctaLoop.internalDriverHypothesis: High-certainty, low-threat framing signaled respect for their time and structural ownership, lowering cognitive load.
ctaLoop.tacticalProbeOrActuator: Maintain identical unhurried tempo through handoff discussion, resisting speeding up on sharp clarifying questions.
ctaLoop.observableFeedbackAndNextMove: Stakeholder treats you as an operational peer and volunteers an unbriefed budget constraint.

deceptiveNonExample.setting: Relationship-building meeting with a client from a high-context, high-politeness corporate culture.
deceptiveNonExample.mirrorSceneMarkdown: Counterpart opens with warm, deferential phrasing ('So sorry to trouble you with our schedule changes, we really appreciate your patience').
deceptiveNonExample.benignRootCause: Ritualized cultural/organizational politeness norms used as social lubricant, not anxiety.
deceptiveNonExample.disconfirmingCue: Relaxed posture, unhurried vocal tempo, and once pleasantries conclude, they state firm non-negotiable contract terms without flinching.
deceptiveNonExample.falsePositiveCost: Misreading polite phrasing as a Status-Tension Leak leads you to underestimate their leverage and overplay your hand.

L2-M02-dominance-overplay-cliff.operationalFocus: Detecting when directive presence crosses a subject's Autonomy Margin and executing an immediate Overplay Rollback.

workedExample.setting: Architecture review with a veteran principal engineer who did not ask for your oversight.
workedExample.sceneMarkdown: You open with crisp directive energy, squaring shoulders across the table: 'Walk me through migration risks in order of severity, keep it high-level.' Engineer's jaw tightens, leans back, replies flatly: 'It's all in the doc.'

ctaLoop.baseline: Casually chatting with teammate prior to your directive, relaxed and animated.
ctaLoop.deviationOrCluster: Sudden jaw tension + backward lean + minimal compliance ('It's all in the doc') right after directive opening.
ctaLoop.internalDriverHypothesis: Dominance Overplay—command tone crossed a high-autonomy expert's Autonomy Margin.
ctaLoop.tacticalProbeOrActuator: Execute Overplay Rollback: angle torso 15 degrees off-center, soften cadence, and restore autonomy: 'Fair point—I read the doc and the rollback plan is solid. You know this stack best; what's the one failure mode you're most annoyed we haven't solved yet?'
ctaLoop.observableFeedbackAndNextMove: Across ~45s (Autonomic Decay Lag), engineer leans in, uncrosses arms, and walks through two undocumented edge cases.

deceptiveNonExample.setting: Identical architecture review with a different principal engineer.
deceptiveNonExample.mirrorSceneMarkdown: You open calmly and collaboratively. Engineer sits back, arms folded, minimal extended eye contact, delivering brief three-sentence technical answers.
deceptiveNonExample.benignRootCause: Natural introverted/analytical baseline combined with deep cognitive processing—concise by temperament, not resisting.
deceptiveNonExample.disconfirmingCue: Answers are substantive and directly solve your questions; zero sarcasm or jaw tension, identical terse posture with closest teammates.
deceptiveNonExample.falsePositiveCost: Over-softening and apologizing dilutes your own Authority Architecture to fix a threat response that never existed.

L3-M02-dominance-vs-prestige.topicTitle: Dual Strategies Theory of Status: Dominance vs. Prestige
L3-M02-dominance-vs-prestige.externalScienceMarkdown: Henrich & Gil-White's (2001) **Dual Strategies Theory of Status** and Cheng et al. (2013) strongly validate the split between Authority Architecture and Dominance Overplay. **Dominance** (coercion/intimidation) produces avoidance and information hoarding; **Prestige** (calm competence and social utility) earns voluntary deference, accurate information, and sustained influence.
L3-M02-dominance-vs-prestige.operationalTranslation: Anchor Authority Architecture strictly in prestige signals (calm certainty, competence, low threat) rather than intimidation.
keyReferences: Henrich & Gil-White (2001) Evolution and Human Behavior

L3-M02-authority-obedience-limits.topicTitle: Milgram Re-Analysis: Engaged Followership & Shared Purpose
L3-M02-authority-obedience-limits.externalScienceMarkdown: Archival re-analyses of Milgram's experiments by Haslam & Reicher (2012, 2017) (**Engaged Followership / Social Identity Theory**) show participants did not obey blindly; they complied only when identifying with the legitimacy of the shared mission. When the experimenter issued raw commands ('You have no other choice'), compliance collapsed.
L3-M02-authority-obedience-limits.operationalTranslation: Somatic presence opens the door, but sustained compliance requires shared purpose—pair Authority Architecture with explicit alignment to a goal the subject values.

L3-M02-primacy-thin-slicing.externalScienceMarkdown: Thin-slicing (Ambady & Rosenthal, 1992) and primacy research (Willis & Todorov, 2006) confirm rapid, sticky competence judgments within seconds. However, Cone & Ferguson (2015) show first impressions are not irreversible—diagnostic, high-impact disconfirming behavior can overturn a weak opening.
L3-M02-primacy-thin-slicing.operationalTranslation: Invest heavily in a clean First-Contact Frame to cut friction early, without fatalism if an opening starts rocky.

L3-M02-hardwired-obedience-myth.topicTitle: Retirement of the Triune / 'Reptilian' Brain Obedience Myth
L3-M02-hardwired-obedience-myth.externalScienceMarkdown: Claims that vocal tones or postures hijack a 'reptilian brain' to force Pavlovian obedience rely on Paul MacLean's retired **Triune Brain model** (Cesario et al., 2020; Feldman Barrett, 2017). Social deference is a distributed, context-sensitive appraisal integrating threat detection, cultural norms, stakes, and prefrontal evaluation.
L3-M02-hardwired-obedience-myth.operationalTranslation: Discard pop-neurology; treat Authority Architecture as a probability shifter reducing social friction, never a mind-control override.
keyReferences: Cesario, Johnson, & Eisthen (2020) Current Directions in Psychological Science

proposedGlossaryAdditions.definition: The variable threshold of directive pressure a specific subject can absorb before perceiving territorial encroachment and triggering Dominance Overplay.
The collapse of an initially strong First-Contact Frame caused by mid-interaction Status-Tension Leaks or lack of directional utility.
